conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Hello, main Rakesh Patel. Mera fixed deposit ka auto-renewal kaise band karoon?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Namaste Rakesh ji, main aapki madad karoonga. Kya aap apna FD number bata sakte hain?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Maine dekha, aapka FD auto-renewal pe set hai. Main ise deactivate kar deta hoon. Maturity ke baad amount aapke account mein credit ho jayega.

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Theek hai, kab tak ho jayega?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Request aaj hi process ho jayegi. Koi aur sawal?
